items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1959-10-03
items.q: And I heard the song about K.C. John, Steamboat Bill.

ctx.x: Oh, well you've been done quite a bit of traveling. Oh yes, I did a lot of that. What's the earliest music or singing that you remember?

Well, the first blues I ever heard was St. Louis Blues. To remember, the first blues I've heard was St. Louis Blues. Then I've heard a lot of other old songs. Songs like, Who Stole a Lock Off the Hen House Door. I heard a song about Big Rock Candy Mountain. And I heard the song about K.C. John, Steamboat Bill. And another old song I used to sing around New Orleans years ago when I was a kid. He'd sing that song about Winter Night and the Junkman Rag. And all those old songs way back here. And songs, old quartet…
How old were you when you heard St. Louis Blues, Lemma?
